title: abrus aureus subsp. littoralis
intro: Abrus aureus subsp. littoralis, commonly known as the golden chain tree, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family. It has been utilized in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of A. aureus subsp. littoralis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. Further research is necessary to confirm the efficacy and safety of A. aureus subsp. littoralis for medicinal use.
